roundTripGaps.description: The kit does not recognize a GFM task-list item inside a blockquote or a nested list, so task lists are top-level only.

The kit parses inline syntax before the math recognizer runs, so a math value holding emphasis, code, link or HTML markers, edge whitespace or a trailing lone backslash does not read back; generated math values hold none of them.

rows.section: a table can be recognised when separated from a paragraph of text without an empty line
When a footnote is used multiple times, we insert multiple backrefs.
Footnote reference labels are href escaped
